name: Anthropic AI for Science — Hardware-Splicer Physical-Agent Study

fields.project_title: Evidence-Constrained Multimodal Agents for Reproducible Physical Engineering Experiments

packet_requirements.description: Prepared future proposal skeleton covering aims, Claude's experimental role, outputs, budget method and data/IP/participation guardrails.
At least one artifact-backed frozen Claude/API experimental run must exist so the scientific workload and API-credit budget are evidence-based.
Hardware-Splicer #105 must produce at least one fresh revision-bound real physical result or preserved failure with measurement lineage.
Current rules allow individual applicants, but affiliated researchers must obtain required institutional consent. Recheck the live application and applicant-specific terms before firing.
Document a clean corpus/data/IP rights boundary and obtain any institutional consent required by current program rules.
Identify the organization/account that would receive credits; current official rules place credits on the organization identified in the application.
Review current publicity/release and research-survey/interview obligations before accepting a selected-researcher position.

Resolve current public-source conflict: Aug 27 expansion announcement says up to US$50,000/project while Help Center still states up to US$20,000 for six months. Use live application/current terms, not the larger headline by default.

compliance_checks: Do not fire solely because a public announcement advertises a large maximum credit award.
Do not choose US$50,000 over US$20,000 without reconciling the current live application/terms.
Do not treat 'any researcher may apply' as eliminating institutional consent when applying as an affiliated university researcher.
Do not include confidential professor/partner/industry data without explicit rights and consent.
Do not claim Claude or fresh physical results before artifact-backed evidence exists.
Derive requested credits from the actual frozen scientific workload and model mix.
Credits and application identity must match the receiving organization/account declared in the application.

wake_gate.physical_evidence: Hardware-Splicer #105 reaches a real revision-bound functional result or preserved physical failure with simulated:false evidence
wake_gate.claude_evidence: at least one frozen Claude/API experimental run exists with artifacts adequate to define the scientific workload
wake_gate.institutional_gate: required YZU/research-institution consent and receiving organization/account are identified
wake_gate.data_rights_gate: all corpus, hardware, partner and unpublished-data rights are explicit
wake_gate.budget_gate: live application/current terms resolve the public $20k vs $50k cap and requested credits are derived from the actual workload
